name: Nou City
summary:
Nou City is an online role-playing game for iPhone and iPad in which players become heroes who save their city. At the start, each player joins one of four brigades that work like character classes: Firefighters, Police, Paramedics and Rangers. Each brigade has its own role, outfit, vehicles and powers, unlocked as the hero levels up from 1 to 30.

Across a coastal island city, players answer emergency calls, catch the Pagaillons, mischievous robots built by Professor Pagaille, and reprogram them into collectible Bricobots. They team up with friends in groups, explore dungeons set in real city locations such as the hospital, and take part in the weekly Great Alert, a city-wide event against a giant storm robot. Mounts, gear and neighbourhood reputation round out the progression.

Between missions, players can rent and decorate a home, run a shop, stand for mayor or take side jobs such as taxi driver.
